verdict.headline: Can't tell
verdict.statement: Greenness (NDVI) fell by 0.03 relative to the control trajectory in the 12 months after 1 Jun 2022 (90% interval −0.07 to +0.03). The same test was run on 60 untouched control cells. In 50 of them the no-event prediction missed by as much after the event date, relative to how closely it matched before, as it did here (placebo p = 0.84). Counted by gap size instead, 1 of the 60 moved at least as far as this area did in the same direction (p = 0.03). But: the control trajectory does not track the area well enough before the event (pre-event error 0.05 vs typical 0.02).
reasons: the control trajectory does not track the area well enough before the event (pre-event error 0.05 vs typical 0.02)

evidence.sentence: Neither optical nor radar shows a change beyond what the controls did.
